title: Zach Bryan’s ‘Young Manhood And Other Donatable Organs’: Stream It Now
summary: The eight-song EP, which includes collabs with Lana Del Rey and Turnpike Troubadours, is out now.
contentText:
Zach Bryan is back with new music, as his EP Young Manhood And Other Donatable Organs is out Friday (Oct. 16) via Warner Records.

The eight-song collection includes collabs with Lana Del Rey (“Lies”) and Turnpike Troubadours (“Plainsman”). Other tracks on the new EP include “Robot Killed The Working Man” and “Backwards.”

The fresh set marks Bryan’s first new music since his sixth studio album, With Heaven On Top , which released in January and debuted atop the all-genre Billboard 200 chart (soon after, he also released an acoustic version of With Heaven On Top ). The 25-song album included “Plastic Cigarette,” which rose to No. 13 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 2 on the Hot Country Songs chart.

Bryan also just announced his upcoming stadium tour, the 2027 Young Manhood And Other Donatable Organs Tour, which will play 19 stadiums across North America and Australia next year. The tour will also feature support from John Fogerty, Ryan Bingham and The Texas Gentlemen, Vance Joy, Fey Fili, Gabriella Rose and Emma Ogier.

Tickets for his tour go on sale to the public Friday, Oct. 23 at 10 a.m. local time at zachbryan.com. The trek launches in North America on April 28 at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, and will include stops at Chicago’s Soldier Field, Atlanta’s Mercedes-Benz Stadium and Philadelphia’s Lincoln Financial Field, before heading to Australia with performances at Melbourne’s Marvel Stadium, Sydney’s Accor Stadium and Brisbane’s Suncorp Stadium.

Bryan is a touring titan. On Billboard’s 2025 year-end Boxscore Top Tours chart , he ranked No. 13 globally with $159.6 million in gross revenue from 941,000 tickets sold.

Bryan earned a Hot 100 chart-topper in 2023, with the Kacey Musgraves collab “I Remember Everything.” In addition to With Heaven On Top , Bryan’s 2023 self-titled project also topped the Billboard 200.
